figures.name: Pangu

ability.name: World Creation
ability.description: Reshape the field completely: reset all card positions and all active effects.

figures.description: The cosmic giant who separated heaven and earth with his axe and whose body became the world.

figures.name: Nu Wa

ability.name: Sky Repair
ability.description: Negate all catastrophic or field-destroying enemy abilities for 2 turns.

figures.description: The serpent-bodied creator goddess who fashioned humans from yellow clay and repaired the broken sky.

figures.name: Jade Emperor

ability.name: Celestial Mandate
ability.description: All ally special abilities are approved: they cannot be denied or countered for 1 turn.

figures.description: Supreme ruler of the celestial bureaucracy whose cosmic administration governs all gods, spirits and humans.

figures.name: Sun Wukong

ability.name: 72 Transformations
ability.description: Transform into any other card on the field; copy their stats and abilities for 2 turns.

figures.description: The irrepressible Monkey King who defeated the armies of heaven, learned 72 transformations and sought immortality.

figures.name: Nezha

ability.name: Universe Ring
ability.description: Deal 6 damage to all enemies; grant +3 speed to all child and youth allies.

figures.description: The rebellious divine child reborn from lotus flowers who wields fire wheels and defies the Dragon Kings.

figures.name: Guan Yu

ability.name: Righteousness
ability.description: All allies with loyalty abilities gain +4 power; enemy betrayal abilities auto-fail.

figures.description: The deified Han general whose absolute loyalty and righteousness made him China's god of war and brotherhood.

figures.name: Zhong Kui

ability.name: Demon Quelling
ability.description: Permanently expel one demon or dark enemy from the battle.

figures.description: The ugly failed scholar who became the supreme queller of demons in the celestial hierarchy.

figures.name: Chang'e

ability.name: Moonlit Grace
ability.description: Grant all allies immunity to darkness for 1 turn; restore 3 HP from moonlight.

figures.description: The moon goddess who drank the immortality elixir and flew to her lonely palace on the moon with her jade rabbit.

figures.name: Lei Gong

ability.name: Thunder Drum
ability.description: Deal 5 thunder damage to all enemies; stun those who committed evil deeds (dark alignment).

figures.description: The drum-bearing thunder deity who punishes the evil and those who escape human justice.

figures.name: Dian Mu

ability.name: Mirror Flash
ability.description: Blind all enemies for 1 turn with lightning mirrors; deal 3 damage to evil-aligned cards.

figures.description: The lightning goddess who illuminates darkness with her mirrors to help Thunder Duke find guilty targets.

figures.name: Dragon King

ability.name: Dragon Rain
ability.description: Restore 3 HP to all water allies; inflict wet status on all fire-type enemies.

figures.description: The four Dragon Kings of the seas who control rain, floods and all ocean power under the Jade Emperor.

figures.name: Eight Immortals

ability.name: Eight Treasures
ability.description: Each of the Eight grants +1 to a different stat: all eight stats on all allies increase by 1.

figures.description: The Eight Immortals each bearing a sacred object and representing diverse paths to immortality.

figures.name: Hou Yi

ability.name: Ten Suns Shot
ability.description: Deal 5 damage to one enemy repeatedly for 3 turns — always hits.

figures.description: The divine archer who shot down nine of the ten suns to save the earth from burning.

figures.name: Gong Gong

ability.name: Heaven's Pillar
ability.description: When this card rages, deal 4 damage to all cards and tilt the field: stats randomize by 1.

figures.description: The water spirit whose rage shattered the pillar of heaven creating floods and tilting the world.

figures.name: Fuxi

ability.name: Eight Trigrams
ability.description: Read the I Ching: look at all enemy future plays for the next 2 turns.

figures.description: The divine creator who invented writing, fishing, music and the I Ching — giver of all civilization.

figures.name: Yellow Emperor

ability.name: Yellow Emperor's Canon
ability.description: All ally healing abilities gain +2 power from the divine emperor's medical wisdom.

figures.description: The legendary Yellow Emperor whose reign established Chinese medicine, writing, music and government.

figures.name: Meng Po

ability.name: Five Flavors Soup
ability.description: Make one enemy forget their most recently used ability; they cannot use it again this battle.

figures.description: The old woman at the bridge of souls who gives the soup of forgetfulness before reincarnation.

figures.name: Tian Gou

ability.name: Eclipse
ability.description: Block all sun and light abilities for 1 turn as the celestial dog swallows the sun.

figures.description: The celestial dog who devours the sun causing eclipses and whose howl triggers celestial disasters.

figures.name: Bai Ze

ability.name: Complete Catalog
ability.description: Reveal the type, abilities and weaknesses of all enemies on the field.

figures.description: The mystical white beast who told the Yellow Emperor about all 11,520 species of supernatural beings.

figures.name: Xiwangmu

ability.name: Immortal Peach
ability.description: Grant one ally immortality for 1 turn; that ally cannot be destroyed during this time.

figures.description: The Queen Mother of the West who tends the peach garden of immortality and hosts the celestial banquets.
